name: Fashion Contract
source:
Fashion designer Jessica and her model friend Rebecca want to rise in their careers, and they join the fashion show. Both girls can help each other at this event.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2356160/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
时装设计师Jessica与她的模特朋友Rebecca，希望在事业上更进一步，于是报名参加时装秀。在这场活动中，两位女孩可以相互扶持。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2356160/]Steam[/url]]
